name: KLIA
summary: Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Sepang: Terminal 1 and its Satellite Building, klia2 and gateway@klia2, the control tower and runways, Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA Sepang and the Sepang International Circuit, around the KLIA and klia2 stations of the KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit.
notes: Study area: 11.2 km x 11.2 km refitted on 2026-11-23 to hold the whole airport: the OSM aerodrome outline (relation/11579113, 2.7015–2.7848 N, 101.6728–101.7281 E) with all three runways (14L/32R way/23099457, 14R/32L way/23099458, 15/33 way/281813467 + way/496374993, south end 2.7085 N), plus Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA Sepang (north-west) and the Sepang International Circuit (east), with a margin (Overpass, 2026-11-23).
